---
title: "Downloads"
engine: knitr
---

Machine-readable tables (CSV: UTF-8, empty cell = missing, `true`/`false`).
`report-dataset.json` lists every table with its columns, row count and SHA-256;
`results-table.jsonl` is the unfiltered `lidarbench.results-table/1` export of
every attempt. The raw campaign records stay unchanged in the campaign
directory (`report.json` lists their SHA-256 digests).

```{r}
#| results: asis
source("lidarbench_report.R")
index <- lb_table("table_index")
if (!is.null(index) && nrow(index)) {
  index$download <- paste0("[", basename(index$file), "](", index$file, ")")
  lb_kable(index, c("download", "rows", "description", "sha256"))
}
cat("- [report-dataset.json](report-dataset.json)\n- [summary.md](summary.md)\n")
```
